# Tanker Shipping

## Bi-Weekly Industry Report

### November 4, 2025

- **VLCCs Go from Strength to Strength as Sanctions Drive Strong Sentiment -** VLCC rates continued their **surge into late October**, led by the Arabian Gulf-China and West Africa-China routes. Strength in these two major eastbound benchmarks has spilled over to the broader VLCC segment, with all regions posting gains as charterers secured coverage across basins amid a thinning vessel list.
